title: Safety and Navigation Efficiency for ForgeBot-DD1
goal_description: Investigate navigation safety and propose a supervised research mission.

hypotheses.title: Increasing Tangential Gain
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the tangential gain will reduce the robot's tendency to veer off course, thereby increasing navigation safety.
hypotheses.mechanism: The tangential gain controls how strongly the robot corrects its path when it deviates from the planned route.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Repulsion Gain
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the repulsion gain will allow the robot to navigate closer to obstacles, potentially reducing the distance traveled and improving efficiency.
hypotheses.mechanism: The repulsion gain determines how strongly the robot avoids obstacles. Lowering this value can make the robot more willing to approach obstacles.
